pr_title: Avoid removing zwave_js devices for non-ready nodes
pr_body:
## Proposed change
If the zwave_js integration receives a `"node added"` event for a node that is not ready but matches an already created device, it will remove the device and re-create it, even if the node is the correct/original one. Removing the device loses all of the user device and entity customization (naming, etc.). Normally, this kind of event is only seen when a node has been included for the first time. It is also emitted for the following scenarios:
1. A cache loss or corruption, where all the node info must be rediscovered
2. Replacing a failed node

Additionally, a third case also causes a device removal: a product name is changed in the driver config file. The device replacement logic mistakenly believes a different node has replaced the original since the labels no longer match.

To correct this, the device registration logic has two main changes:
1. Skip removing devices which don't have a manufacturer id / product id / product type. In this state it's impossible to determine if a node is being replaced or not. This fixes the first two issues listed.
2. Register the node's manufacturer id / product id / product type fields as an additional device ID and use that to determine whether a node is replacing an existing one or not. These IDs are static and take the place of the device labels. This fixes the second and third issue.

Hey there @home-assistant/z-wave, mind taking a look at this pull request as it has been labeled with an integration (`zwave_js`) you are listed as a [code owner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L623) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>

@MartinHjelmare I'm still planning to complete this, just haven't had much time to do so recently.

I can confirm that your comments about the Value references are correct. After replacing the node, the entity states do not change when the device does something. That's something I didn't pay attention to earlier, good catch.

Latest commits are working, when a node is replaced all of the entities go unavailable until the node becomes ready. After ready state, the entities are all working again, including the node status sensor.

When a node is replace, the driver will send "value removed" and a corresponding "metadata updated" event for each value (I'm not sure why the metadata updated event is there). I'm using that event to trigger an entity to remove itself. It might be more appropriate for the node removal event to also trigger entity removals (or instead of), in case some value was missed. I wasn't sure what the correct way is to tell all entities to remove themselves.

The node status sensor is special, which no associated value Id, so I'm using the event dispatcher to send a message. It's a little awkward to send the event, as it relies on knowing how the entity's unique ID is made.

Looks like I need to add some tests as well, I'll do that after I get some feedback, since I'm not so sure about this approach.
Sounds good. I think it's ok to use the value removed event to trigger an entity remove.
Sorry for the rebase, I had an dev environment issue that I thought might be related to being out of date. Also resolved a merge conflict in the test code.
this issue seems to be coming up more and more often - as a result I've tagged this for a patch release

issue_context.title: Replacing a failed node removes the device and all customizations (zwave_js)
issue_context.body:
### The problem

When using the "Replace failed node" command in zwavejs2mqtt (not available in HA yet), the device entry in HA gets removed and re-added. When this happens all customization to the device and its entities are lost, e.g. friendly names and entity IDs.

Typically, "Replace failed node" is used to replace an existing node with the same device. The node ID is preserved in the process. I would expect the device and entities to remain untouched in HA if I replace a failed node with an identical.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.10.6

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Core

### Integration causing the issue

Z-Wave JS

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/zwave_js/

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
2021-10-31 23:23:17 DEBUG (MainThread) [zwave_js_server] Received message:
WSMessage(type=<WSMsgType.TEXT: 1>, data='{"type":"event","event":{"source":"controller","event":"node added","node":{"nodeId":36,"index":0,"status":4,"ready":false,"isSecure":true,"location":"Family Room","interviewAttempts":1,"endpoints":[{"nodeId":36,"index":0,"deviceClass":null}],"values":[],"deviceClass":null,"commandClasses":[{"id":159,"name":"Security 2","version":1,"isSecure":true}],"interviewStage":"None","statistics":{"commandsTX":9,"commandsRX":9,"commandsDroppedRX":0,"commandsDroppedTX":0,"timeoutResponse":0},"highestSecurityClass":0},"result":{}}}', extra='')

2021-10-31 23:23:17 DEBUG (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.zwave_js] Node added: 36 - waiting for it to become ready
2021-10-31 23:23:17 DEBUG (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.zwave_js] async_on_node_added: calling register_node_in_dev_reg
2021-10-31 23:23:17 DEBUG (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.zwave_js] Removing device, old model=HS-FC200+, new model=None, old mfg=HomeSeer Technologies, new mfg=None
```


### Additional information

Full logfile: 
[home-assistant.log](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/files/7451156/home-assistant.log)

I added some additional debug logs, shown in the snippet above (async_on_node_added). A `node read` even is received prior to the node being interviewed, so none of the node properties are available yet.

There was a previous PR submitted that attempts to handle this case, but it doesn't seem to be working as expected now. https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/56599

node-zwave-js version 8.6.1
zwave-js-server 1.10.7

It will also enable disabled entities.
didn't we discuss this issue a while back? I thought I had implemented a fix. Maybe it's not working as intended

Yeah, I linked the PR you added. 😉 I don't think I ever tested it myself. When you lose cache or replace a failed node, you still get a node added event, but the node is not ready. This code is registering the device in the non-ready state and trying to remove it because the node properties are all None.

https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/96c03aec06a24f8bb6f1957c19fb4bed9ca2175e/homeassistant/components/zwave_js/__init__.py#L302-L304

Maybe `remove_device` should be `None` in that call if the node isn't ready?

On a related subject, I think this replacement check is problematic:

https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/96c03aec06a24f8bb6f1957c19fb4bed9ca2175e/homeassistant/components/zwave_js/__init__.py#L123-L126

I have a node that has changed model names between releases. I haven't tried it yet, but I assume this is going to remove the device. A better approach would be to add the mfg/product id/product type as either the device ID or an additional identifier. Those values are static and don't depend on labels.

@kpine - ah thanks for that. Didn't look that far back.

Is there any dev branch w/ a potential fix that can be used?   Currently have all none-working devices atm..
It's fixed in the dev branch.

Confirming that it is the supervisor dev branch per [these docs?](https://www.home-assistant.io/common-tasks/os/)

```
ha supervisor options --channel dev
```

Those instructions worked. Now on core-2022.2.0.dev20220111 and zwave lock, keypad, motion working again.

@kpine - based on the logs saying the db schema was updating, I take it that I cannot go back to the master branch until 2022.2.0 is released?
Sorry, I don't know the answer to that.

Attaching my [zwave json dump](https://gist.github.com/rchukka/aae1d6d805ddebf4749f796591145e52) just in case if you can use it for your test cases.
The issue is already closed. Try upgrading HA and see if the problem still affects you.
